claim.claim-text: 1. A method, comprising: by a cellular base station (BS)

determining that a plurality of user equipment devices (UEs) should transmit an aperiodic sounding reference signal (SRS) to the cellular base station; and transmitting a downlink control information (DCI) message to the plurality of UEs, wherein the DCI message includes information useable in identifying respective LTEs of the plurality of UEs, wherein the DCI message is configured to cause the respective UEs of the plurality of LTEs to transmit respective SRS signals to the cellular base station.

2. The method of claim 1, wherein the information useable in identifying the respective LTEs of the plurality of UEs comprises a radio network temporary identifier (RNTI) that is common for the respective LTEs of the plurality of LTEs.

3. The method of claim 1, wherein the information useable in identifying the respective LTEs of the plurality of LTEs comprises a cyclic redundancy check (CRC) scrambled with an aperiodic SRS radio network temporary identifier that is common for the respective LTEs of the plurality of LTEs.

4. The method of claim 1, further comprising: establishing respective radio resource control (RRC) connections with the respective UEs of the plurality of UEs in a group, wherein during establishment of the respective RRC connections with the respective UEs of the plurality of UEs, the cellular base station operates to configure the respective LTEs as being members of the group.
5. The method of claim 4, wherein the DCI message comprises an aperiodic SRS trigger state for the respective LTEs of the plurality of LTEs in the group.
6. The method of claim 1, wherein the DCI message has a DCI format of 0_1 or 0_2.
7. The method of claim 1, wherein the DCI message has a DCI format of 2_3.
8. The method of claim 1, further comprising:

determining that a plurality of groups of UEs should transmit aperiodic SRSs to the cellular base station, wherein respective groups of the plurality of groups of UEs comprise a respective plurality of LTEs; and transmit a downlink control information (DCI) message to the plurality of groups of UEs, wherein the DCI message includes information useable in identifying respective groups of the plurality of groups of UEs, wherein the DCI message is configured to cause the respective plurality of UEs in respective groups of the plurality of groups of UEs to generate respective SRS signals to the cellular base station.

9. The method of claim 8, wherein the information useable in identifying respective groups of the plurality of groups of UEs comprises a plurality of group radio network temporary identifiers (RNTIs), wherein respective group RNTIs identify respective LTEs belonging to respective groups.

10. The method of claim 8, wherein a cyclic redundancy check (CRC) of a format of the DCI message may be scrambled with an aperiodic Sounding Reference Signal - Radio Network Temporary Identifier (SRS-RNTI) which is common for respective LTEs belonging to respective groups.
11. The method of claim 10, wherein a CRC of a format of the DCI message may be scrambled with a group aperiodic SRS-RNTI which is different for respective groups of LTEs.
12. The method of claim 11, wherein the group aperiodic SRS-RNTI may be used to identify UEs in respective groups of UEs being targeted.
13. An apparatus, comprising: at least one processor configured to cause a cellular base station to perform the method of any of claims 1-12.
14. The apparatus of claim 13, further comprising:
wireless communication circuitry operably coupled to the at least one processor; and one or more antennas operably coupled to the wireless communication circuitry.

15. A non-transitory computer readable storage medium storing program instructions executable by one or more processors of a cellular base station to cause the cellular base station to perform the method of any of claims 1-12.
